meta.v2: Look v2 (Aether light + Lumen Edge dark), designed 11 Oct 2026 to move away from the original zinc/Inter look; spacing, motion and Black & White values are kept from the code and the B&W audit.

tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page ground. Aether: cool pearl. Lumen Edge: near-black graphite.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Solid cards, dialogs, menus, fields (solid style).

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Tracks, hover rows, skeletons, icon wells.

tokens.name: surface-canvas
tokens.usage: The drag-and-drop board behind placed blocks.

tokens.name: line-100
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside cards and tables.

tokens.name: line-200
tokens.usage: Card, field and menu hairline borders at rest.

tokens.name: line-300
tokens.usage: Edit-mode borders, dashed drop zones, secondary-button outlines. Decorative: state is also shown by the focus ring or glow.

tokens.name: edge-light
tokens.usage: The inset top highlight on glass and cards (Aether bevel / Lumen top edge). Decorative only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-label
tokens.usage: Labels and secondary emphasis on surface-000/100/200 and glass.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, captions, widget labels, table meta on surface-000/100/200.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and the muted 'No' in the wordmark. Decorative only.

tokens.name: brand-solid
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary pills, active nav, the mark. Aether charcoal / Lumen Edge light.

tokens.name: brand-solid-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-solid.

tokens.name: lumen
tokens.usage: Lumen Edge's line of light: focus rings, active outlines, the beam in the mark. In light it falls back to charcoal.

tokens.name: brand-ocean
tokens.usage: Ocean preset (deep teal). Becomes brand-solid when the firm picks Ocean.

tokens.name: brand-ocean-ink
tokens.usage: Text on brand-ocean.

tokens.name: brand-forest
tokens.usage: Forest preset (olive).

tokens.name: brand-forest-ink
tokens.usage: Text on brand-forest.

tokens.name: brand-sunset
tokens.usage: Sunset preset (burnt amber).

tokens.name: brand-sunset-ink
tokens.usage: Text on brand-sunset.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px outline, 2px offset; in dark it also glows (shadow-lumen).

tokens.name: in
tokens.usage: Series 1 / money in / on time: chart fills, kind badges. Teal. 5.6:1 on white; pair with the arrow icon.

tokens.name: out
tokens.usage: Series 2 / money out / late: fills and icons only. Amber; teal vs amber is colour-blind safe.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive deltas and saved states, always with an icon or sign.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-surface
tokens.usage: Error panels and danger hover ground.

tokens.name: info-surface
tokens.usage: Info chips such as 'Includes sample data'.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Text on info-surface.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines, axes and the dot grid.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dialog backdrop, blurred 8px.

tokens.name: glass-surface
tokens.usage: Glass panes; always with 20px backdrop blur, edge-light and a hairline.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Glass hairline border.

tokens.name: glass-tint
tokens.usage: Ground behind glass; the page paints a soft radial glow on top.

tokens.name: neu-ground
tokens.usage: Neumorphic ground shared by raised and inset shapes. Text: ink / ink-label only.

tokens.name: neu-light
tokens.usage: Neumorphic highlight.

tokens.name: neu-dark
tokens.usage: Neumorphic shade.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Collect leave, enrolment and incident forms in one place.

styles.name: kpi
styles.usage: KPI figures. Mono, tabular, so numbers line up like a ledger.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: KPI labels, status labels, section eyebrows. Uppercase mono.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numbers, dates and IDs in tables.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Segmented-control inner padding (table density toggle).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Track padding, icon-button padding.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Compact row block padding; label-to-field gap; icon-button padding in widget headers.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button block padding; small gaps.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Comfortable row block padding; ghost-button inline padding; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field inline padding; form row gap; menu item inline padding.

tokens.name: space-3.5
tokens.usage: Primary-button inline padding; widget body gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Table cell inline padding; compact card padding; widget header bottom margin.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Comfortable widget/card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog body padding and header inline padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section gaps on dashboards.

tokens.name: control-h-compact
tokens.usage: Compact density: buttons, fields, segmented items.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Comfortable density (default): buttons and fields — 20px line + 2×8px.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Compact density table row block padding (py-1.5).

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: Comfortable density table row block padding (py-2.5).

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area on touch / mobile for drag handles and icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Legend keys, kbd hints, tiny chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Segments inside a track, icon buttons, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Fields' inner wells, menus, tooltips, palette blocks.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, widgets, the mark tile.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, the product window on the landing page.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: every button, input, segmented track, chip and avatar.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Fields and segments at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and widgets: bevel highlight plus soft ambient shadow (light); top edge of light plus deep shadow (dark).

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the dragged widget, dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-lumen
tokens.usage: Focus and active state: a ring in light, a thin line of light with glow in dark.

tokens.name: shadow-neu-raised
tokens.usage: Neumorphic raised.

tokens.name: shadow-neu-inset
tokens.usage: Neumorphic inset.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Flat motion mode and prefers-reduced-motion: every transition.

tokens.name: duration-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback. Must land under 100ms or it reads as lag.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: State changes: colour, border, shadow, selected segment. Never over 150ms.

tokens.name: duration-exit
tokens.usage: Exits and dismissals (menu, dialog, toast out) — about 40% faster than the entrance.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Hover lift on primary CTAs (-2px).

tokens.name: duration-enter
tokens.usage: Entrances: reveals, dialogs, sheets, a dropped widget settling. Ease-out, never past 300ms.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Attention only (a toast or notification arriving, the hero strike-mark). Never for entrances.

tokens.name: duration-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between siblings in a reveal group: 30ms blurs into one block, 100ms crawls.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled primary and danger buttons.

tokens.name: opacity-placeholder
tokens.usage: Drop placeholder left behind by a dragged widget.

tokens.name: opacity-dim
tokens.usage: Non-hovered chart series while another is hovered.
